title: fix(runtime)!: the package draft doors refuse a query parameter they do not read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAR1TDS8qyw6DaeA7t9jepP)_

Fixes #26713

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches a query parameter on either draft door: `skills/**` and `content/docs` name `publish-drafts` / `discard-drafts` only in `plugin-hooks.md`, `metadata-api.mdx` (a route list) and two reference tables, none with a query string, and no caller in `ui/**`, `packages/client`, the CLI or `skills/**` sends one.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:包的两个草稿门 `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` 与 `discard-drafts` 现在拒收任何查询参数,答 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`,文案用仓里唯一的那句「不认识的查询参数」。
- 为什么改:`publish-drafts?dryRun=true` 以前忽略参数、真的发布草稿并答 200 `published`;想预览的工具与 AI 拿到的是不可逆的发布。
- 风险与回滚:只拒带查询参数的请求;控制台、`MetadataClient`、SDK 都不带参数,行为不变。回滚即还原 `packages.ts` 一处 helper 与两行调用。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `refuseDraftDoorQuery` 与两处调用(在权限与 wall 闸之后、协议之前);其次新测试 `packages-draft-doors-closed-query.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd packages/runtime && pnpm exec vitest run src/domains/packages-draft-doors-closed-query.test.ts`,预期 10 passed;带 `?dryRun=true` 的两例答 400 且协议未被调用。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: the draft doors' closed query set is declared (`DRAFT_DOOR_QUERY_PARAMS`, measured EMPTY: both doors read the path id, the session and the body, never the query), and `refuseDraftDoorQuery` answers any name on the query string `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage` from `@objectstack/rest`, the recognition sentence every closed-query door answers, written through `deps.error` with the code the way the `/meta` doors write it (#23072). No new sentence, no new code, no helper copied.
- Placement: after `requireManageMetadata` and `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`, before the protocol is resolved, the #23214 placement on this domain's other write doors. A caller without `manage_metadata` keeps its `403`.
- `discard-drafts` is closed in the same change: it is the twin door the order names, reads no query either, and `?dryRun=true` there dropped every pending draft. Its hunk is the same one call line.
- ⛔ No `dryRun`. A dry run would be a declared parameter and a protocol addition, which goes back to triage.
- Transports: only the runtime dispatcher serves these two doors (`dispatcher-plugin.ts` `mountPackagesRoute`, and the `@objectstack/hono` catch-all into the same `dispatch()`); `RestServer` mounts neither (`packages/rest/src` has no route for them), so there is one place to close.
- Changeset `@objectstack/runtime` patch, with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

## Why

The QA run (S3) measured `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts?dryRun=true` with `{}` answering `200 outcome: "published"` with the draft live. A caller asking for a preview got the irreversible act, shaped like a success. Triage `6446824931` ruled: close the query set and refuse an unknown parameter with 400.

## Tests

`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-draft-doors-closed-query.test.ts`, 10 cases, driving `dispatch()` over a real `SchemaRegistry` and a recording protocol, for each door:

- refusal: `{dryRun: 'true'}`, a repeated `dryRun`, and two unknown names each answer 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with exactly `unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage(query, [])`, every name quoted, and the protocol's `publishPackageDrafts` / `discardPackageDrafts` never called;
- preservation: no query, 200, the protocol called once;
- order: a caller without `manage_metadata` sending `?dryRun=true` gets 403, protocol not called.

There is no declared flag on either door, so the order's "repeated declared flag still refused the #23214 way" has nothing to pin here; a repeated unknown name is answered by recognition, which runs first (the `query-allowlist.ts` rule).

<details><summary>Red first on base c8583f80, green on head, ablation</summary>

- Red, base `c8583f80` (implementation absent): the new file 6 failed | 4 passed (`expected 400, got {"status":200,..."outcome":"published"...}` and the discard twin `discardedCount: 1`).
- Real-door probe (one-off, not committed; real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` over SQLite, one pending view draft, `handlePackages('/com.example.repairs/publish-drafts', 'POST', {}, {dryRun:'true'})`):
  - base: `{"status":200,"code":null,"outcome":"published","draftsBefore":["view/repairs_board"],"draftsAfter":[],"servedLabel":"Board v1"}`: the draft went live.
  - head: `{"status":400,"code":"VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"The \"dryRun\" query parameter is not supported by this endpoint. ... This endpoint takes no query parameters.","draftsBefore":["view/repairs_board"],"draftsAfter":["view/repairs_board"],"servedLabel":null}`: nothing published, the draft still pending.
- Ablation on head `e542b231` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `if (message === undefined) return null;` → `... || true ...`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `8dcfe74db65c` → `f592f4389363`): 6 failed | 4 passed, exactly the six refusal cases; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the dispatcher from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

Sibling package write doors, measured on `c8583f80` (none of them is changed here):

| door | closed query set? |
|---|---|
| `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` (per-item publish, `RestServer`) | yes, `META_ITEM_PUBLISH_PARAMS` (#22877) |
| `POST /packages` (install), reads `overwrite` | no; repeats refused (#23214), unknown names ignored |
| `DELETE /packages/:id` (uninstall), reads `keepData` | no; repeats refused (#23214), unknown names ignored |
| `PATCH /packages/:id`, `PATCH /:id/enable`, `PATCH /:id/disable`, `POST /:id/publish`, `/:id/revert`, `/:id/rollback`, `/:id/commits/:c/revert`, `/:id/adopt-orphans`, `/:id/duplicate` | no; none reads the query |
| `POST /packages/publish` (`RestServer` package route) | no; reads no query |

Measured at the dispatcher door with the `packages-write-flag-arity` harness: `DELETE /packages/:id?keepdata=true` (and `?keep_data=true`) answers 200 and calls `deletePackage({ packageId })` with no `keepData`, so the protocol drops the object tables the caller asked to keep. That is reported to the seat as a proposed card, not widened into this PR.

- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on this diff named 60 families; all 60 ran and exited 0; `--ran` reconciliation: `60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Two first-pass exit 3s were container prerequisites, re-run after fixing them: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (positive-control commit fetched) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (the seven packages without `dist/` built: 112 entries across 69 packages load).

- `test:repo` (vitest `repo` project): not run locally; the diff touches no repo-project test and the derived list does not name it; CI Test Core runs it.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the dispatch contract's Chinese summary).
